detail.longDescription:
We just launched ForgePort - a CLI tool that migrates repositories from GitHub to OpenCommit (or any Forgejo-based forge).

Migrate one repo or bulk-migrate a whole user/org, pick what moves (issues, PRs, milestones, wiki, releases), and dry-run first with -dryrun. Written in Go, EUPL-1.2 licensed.

Read more: https://opencommit.nl/en/news/forgeport/

Your code deserves a home that shares your values. Moving in just got easier. 🧡

#opencommit #forgeport #forgejo @forgejo@floss.social  #opensource #github #migrate
